events.title: 9 Languages Ready for Launch
events.summary: 🌍 Fuel Station Simulator – Fully Localized in 9 LanguagesWhen Fuel Station Simulator hits Early Access this October, it will be fully localized in 9 languages from day one.🇬🇧 English🇩🇪 German🇫🇷 French🇪🇸 Spanish🇵🇱 Polish🇹🇷 Turkish🇷🇺 Russian🇧🇷 Portuguese (BR)🇮🇹 ItalianEvery menu, tooltip, and line of in-game text will be available in your language on launch day. Switch at any time in Settings – no restart needed.

events.title: Release Date and News
events.summary: Hey everyone,First off – thank you for your support! Truly, thank you! :) Yes – I know – it's been quiet for a while, but creating a game of this scale turned out to be a lot more work than expected. I simply didn't want to release something unfinished, nor rely on AI. I wanted it to be properly playable.Now for the "Why": Why a gas station simulator, anyway? events.title: Fuel Station Simulator - Copy?
events.summary: Unfortunately, we recently discovered that another developer has renamed their game to match ours. Although we have opened a case with Steam, it is likely not something we can take action against – nor do we intend to. Our focus is on creating a new game, not on questionable tactics from competitors. We have no connection whatsoever to the other game with the same name.

events.title: Happy new year! (and some quick news..) ;-)
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995273/d2c19c6bc91f796d8df62c647f12b87b95416a6f.jpg At the end of the year, there hasn't been much news about Fuel Station Simulator. We want to thank everyone for the many wishlists and are excited to announce that the release is just around the corner. We hope you’ll have as much fun playing the game as we had creating it. To wrap things up, we wish you a wonderful and healthy 2025 for you and your loved ones. See you soon (at the pump)!

events.title: Fuel Station Simulator storepage live!
events.summary: Hello everyone! It has already been very exciting for us up to this point. But yesterday it finally happened and our store page went online, which was a very big step for us. Here we want to give you the opportunity to get news about the game already now, as well as to exchange ideas with each other and to get in touch with us. We are very much looking forward to everything that is happening now!
